modeHookNote: js/darkmode-prepaint.js and js/darkmode.js mark the dark side with three marks on the root, set and cleared together ("T4 dark hook is three things at once"): data-theme="dark", data-bs-theme="dark" and the class t4-dark, which css/darkmode.css keys on (310 html.t4-dark selectors) along with the logo pair (span.d-light / span.d-dark). The Design system popup Light | Dark and the slot sides read and set all three (src/sides.mjs, design-system-live-page.js; grammar from d2aa12a507). With the default data-theme hook a press set only data-theme: in the live frame on the published 1.0.7 under Moxie the page kept the other side logo (the dark-side logo on the light page and back), the other side page wrapper ground and the top bar link colours, 62 to 66 visible elements off on the home page alone (18/10/2026). selectors.themeToggle .ja-theme-toggle (the header and drawer buttons, data-theme-toggle) lets the flow turn the hooked page with the template switch, as a visitor does.
modesNote: 17/10/2026 (batch 2, MODE-3): JA Vogue has a light/dark switch (the header moon, js/darkmode.js; css/darkmode.css paints html.t4-dark / data-theme=dark) and its pre-paint resolver always sets data-theme on <html> before the first paint (cookie, then the template default, then the OS), so there is no unmarked auto state: the module writes the system's own side under the template's matching mode and the other side derived from it, and the switch stays shown under a system. On the dark side the template shows its dark-mode logo (.d-dark, white), so the dark-side logo inversion only touches a logo outside .d-dark; the footer logo module's plain picture (a profile whose site logo is another file, home-2) turns white there as the template's own darkmode.css does.
